$comment: DP18: exact-lane export bytes every host produces for these examples (Node serial and auto in runtime-e2e, every browser engine in ui-e2e). Exports always replay on the serial L0 build, and GLB normals are normalized with the correctly rounded Math.sqrt, so a change here is a Class-X pin event: attribute it before updating. The GLB pin covers the file with its asset.generator version replaced by <version> (libs/tau-examples/src/exact-pin.ts, which both hosts hash through), so a release of the group alone leaves it unchanged; every other byte, materials and buffers included, still moves it.
